### 1924-1925 - Sophistes Commentary

`heidegger-ga-19-platon-sophistes-commentary`

- **presupposed** · `sorge/ga19/001` · *Sorge*
  Sorge is listed among the terms the commentary holds in German throughout, glossed as care, alongside ἀλήθεια, λόγος, οὐσία and Dasein.
  `heidegger-ga-19-platon-sophistes-commentary#h2-orientation-the-traps-this-course-sets` · [Orientation: the traps this course sets](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-19-platon-sophistes-commentary.html#orientation-the-traps-this-course-sets)
  > Terms held in Greek or German throughout, with the English fixed on first use: ἀλήθεια (un-concealment), ἀληθεύειν (disclosing, being-in-the-truth), λόγος (speech/discourse), δηλοῦν (making-manifest), οὐσία (being, in the Greek sense of presence/standing-presence), Dasein (the human being in its being), Sorge (care).

### 1925 - Commentary on Heidegger, Prolegomena zur Geschichte des Zeitbegriffs (GA 20)

`heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary`

- **introduced** · `sorge/ga20/001` · *Sorge*
  The being-structure of in-being that the analysis has been driving at is named care, and the explication is ordered into four phenomena with care last.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-27-in-being-and-care-outline` · GA 20 § 27 · [§ 27. In-being and care: outline](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary.html#in-being-and-care-outline)
  > Heidegger names the being-structure sought *care* (Sorge), and orders the explication of in-being fourfold: the phenomenon of *uncoveredness*, *falling* as a basic movedness of Dasein, the structure of *uncanniness* (from being-at-home — familiarity), and *care*.

- **presupposed** · `sorge/ga20/002` · *care*
  Disposedness is derived from care: the world is experienced as threatening or unthreatening only because Dasein is itself care, and not because a caring Dasein apprehends it so.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-28-the-phenomenon-of-uncoveredness-entdecktheit` · GA 20 § 28a · [§ 28. The phenomenon of uncoveredness (Entdecktheit)](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary.html#the-phenomenon-of-uncoveredness-entdecktheit)
  > And only because *Dasein is itself, at itself, care* is the world experienced in its threateningness, its significance.

- **introduced** · `sorge/ga20/003` · *Sorge*
  Care is the term for the being of Dasein as such, with the formal structure: a being to which, in its being-in-the-world, this being itself is at issue.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-31-care-as-the-being-of-dasein` · GA 20 § 31a · [§ 31. Care as the being of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary.html#care-as-the-being-of-dasein)
  > Care is the term for the being of Dasein *simpliciter*, with the formal structure: *a being to which, in its being-in-the-world, this being itself is at issue*.

- **introduced** · `sorge/ga20/004` · *Urstruktur*
  Care is marked a pre-structure and explicitly the penultimate phenomenon, with time named as the last nexus of the being of Dasein.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-31-care-as-the-being-of-dasein` · GA 20 § 31a · [§ 31. Care as the being of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary.html#care-as-the-being-of-dasein)
  > Heidegger marks it as a *pre-structure* (Urstruktur) in the sense of Dasein itself — not the *last* nexus of the being of Dasein (that will be time), but the *penultimate* phenomenon through which the proper being-structure can be reached.

- **revised** · `sorge/ga20/005` · *Besorgen*
  Concern, which carried the earlier analysis of everyday commerce with the world, is subordinated to care as one of its being-modes.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-31-care-as-the-being-of-dasein` · GA 20 § 31a · [§ 31. Care as the being of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary.html#care-as-the-being-of-dasein)
  > *concern* (Besorgen) is only a being-mode of care — care qua structure of Dasein *is* in-being as concern; caring that is in the world is *eo ipso* concern.

- **introduced** · `sorge/ga20/006` · *Sich-vorweg-sein*
  The total formal structure of care is given in two moments: being-ahead-of-itself, and always-already-being-alongside something.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-31-care-as-the-being-of-dasein` · GA 20 § 31a · [§ 31. Care as the being of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary.html#care-as-the-being-of-dasein)
  > So the total structure of care in the formal sense: *the being-ahead-of-itself of Dasein in its always-already-being-alongside something*.

- **introduced** · `sorge/ga20/007` · *Darben*
  The not-yet-having belonging to being-out-for is named want or privation and distinguished from a sheer objective not-having.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-31-care-as-the-being-of-dasein` · GA 20 § 31a · [§ 31. Care as the being of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary.html#care-as-the-being-of-dasein)
  > which Heidegger names *want* or *privation* (Darben): not a sheer objective not-having, but always a not-having *of something one is out for*

- **revised** · `sorge/ga20/008` · *Drang*
  Urge and hang are founded modifications of care in which one moment predominates and covers the rest; care is the condition of their possibility and is not composed out of them.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-31-care-as-the-being-of-dasein` · GA 20 § 31b · [§ 31. Care as the being of Dasein](https://faultynode.github.io/commentaries/commentaries/heidegger/heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary.html#care-as-the-being-of-dasein)
  > Urge is a being-mode of care — the *not-yet-freed* care — but care is *not* an urge

- **presupposed** · `sorge/ga20/009` · *Sorge*
  Heidegger dates his first striking on the phenomenon of care to seven years before the course, in work on the ontological foundations of Augustinian anthropology.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-31-care-as-the-being-of-dasein` · GA 20 § 31, Cura fable · [§ 31.   > he first struck on the phenomenon of care seven years earlier while trying to reach the ontological foundations of Augustinian anthropology

- **presupposed** · `sorge/ga20/010` · *Sorge*
  Care is the primary wholeness of Dasein's being-constitution; the equiprimordial structures belong to it rather than composing it.
  `heidegger-ga-20-prolegomena-zur-geschichte-des-zeitbegriffs-commentary#h4-s-32-the-result-and-the-task-of-the-fundamental-dasein-analysis-the-working-out` · GA 20 § 32 · [§ 32.
